text:
priya: Heads-up — proposing audit-event schema changes. Plan: introduce schema_version v2beta, add `session_id` and `kms_key_id`, and remove `legacy_actor_addr`. Need to coordinate RBAC impacts, KMS metadata, and a customer-facing validation tool.

noah: +1 on v2beta. We should keep a compatibility shim for consumers who still read legacy fields. Nonbreaking by default, opt-in for v2.

elaine: Flagging RBAC question: some consumers rely on legacy_actor_addr to map service accounts. If we remove it outright some repos will lose auditability. Suggest we map legacy_actor_addr -> actor.identifiers. We also need to confirm KMS key disclosure policy.

jun: For KMS: include only `kms_key_id` (opaque identifier) and never the full key material. That should be safe for compliance teams. Update KMS docs.

priya: Agreed. Drafted a validation header we'll use so customers can opt into v2beta in staging: `X-Audit-Schema: audit.v2beta`. Example event header:

```json
{"schema_version":"audit.v2beta","timestamp":"2024-11-12T15:00:00Z"}
```

sam: Can you add a small shim service we run on ingestion that accepts both shapes and writes normalized events to the store? Then we can run dual-write during the migration window.

priya: Yes — propose migration phases:
- Phase 0: announce and publish spec + customer validator tool.
- Phase 1 (opt-in): customers enable `X-Audit-Schema: audit.v2beta` and run validator against their ingestion.
- Phase 2 (dual-write): our ingestion accepts both shapes and writes normalized canonical events, with extra telemetry.
- Phase 3 (cutover): flip default to v2, keep shim for 90 days, then remove.

elaine: Add an RBAC checklist for Phase 2: ensure service accounts that read audit events get access to `actor.identifiers` and `session_id`. Confirm any UI surfaces that summarize actor info still work.

noah: Also add a regression test: ensure alerts that rely on actor.ip don't break. We'll add a migration mapping in detection rules to use `actor.meta.client_ip` fallback.

priya: I'm adding owners and tentative dates in the thread:
- Spec doc & validator CLI (owner: priya) — ETA 2024-11-20
- Shim / ingestion normalization (owner: sam) — ETA 2024-12-05
- RBAC rule updates (owner: elaine) — ETA 2024-12-01
- Customer outreach + opt-in window (owner: noah) — starts 2024-11-25

jun: Quick implementation note: keep event size deterministic. New `session_id` must be ≤ 64 chars. We'll enforce in ingestion.

priya: Example of the canonical event shape we intend to publish (simplified):

```json
{"schema_version":"audit.v2beta","event_type":"token.create","actor":{"id":"svc-123","identifiers":{"legacy":"10.1.2.3","client_ip":"203.0.113.42"}},"session_id":"s-9a8b7c","kms_key_id":"key-xyz","details":{}}
```

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: audit-validators v0.1 -> staging at 2024-11-18T03:00:00Z :rocket:

priya: Customer-facing validator plan: build a small CLI + GitHub Action that runs sample events against our validator endpoint and reports mismatches. We'll publish a migration guide with `diff` examples and mapping rules.

customer-validator-bot: New validator beta available: https://internal.tools/audit-validator/v2beta — returns PASS/WARN/FAIL and a `migration_hints` array.

priya: Risks & open questions:
- Will any external customers depend on raw `legacy_actor_addr` logs? (action: noah to compile list)
- SLA/retention impact if dual-write doubles storage temporarily — finance input needed (sam).
- Legal check on `kms_key_id` exposure (elaine + legal).

noah: I'll run a quick query across last 90 days to list consumers referencing `legacy_actor_addr`.

sam: I'll model storage impact and ping finance.

elaine: Legal OK with `kms_key_id` as opaque IDs only, they asked to avoid any KMS ARNs that leak account numbers. We'll redact ARNs in the shim.

priya: Final call: we'll post the spec doc tomorrow and start outreach. If anyone has objections to the phased approach, speak up now. Otherwise I'll open PRs for the spec and validator code. :thumbsup:
